Making moves in
Huntsville?

Let’s find where you’ll love to live.

Home is more than four walls and a roof. It’s where you unwind, spend time with your people, and make memories. We’re Paula and Sawyer Tisch of The NorthStar Group, and we’d love to help you find that feeling here. From South Huntsville to Hampton Cove, we share a look at life around town through neighborhood tours—and the occasional search for a good local donut shop.

Buying or selling can feel overwhelming, especially when you’re figuring out where to start. We’ll listen to what you need, keep you updated, and walk through the details with you. Moving from out of town? We can help you explore homes through virtual tours, too. Whether you’re coming to Huntsville or making a move across town, we’re here to help you feel at home.

Let’s find your
new home.

No matter where you are in your life, buying or selling a home is not only a business transaction – but an emotional event. Having the right team beside you will be instrumental in shaping your overall experience.

That’s where we come in.

Our top priority, as REALTORS®, is to ensure that your experience is exceptional. At NorthStar, we strive to help you feel at ease and confident in your decisions and outcomes. We understand that a home is not just a physical structure but a space where cherished memories are created. By partnering with us, you can be certain that you will love where you live.
